blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.
blocks.zh: Vision-Language-Action(VLA)模型从视觉观测和语言指令中生成机器人动作,但他们对物理动态的了解仍然有限. 视频世界模型可以捕捉到场景动态,而未来生成的视频将高潜入控制回路. 我们引入了PDRVLA,其轻量级物理动力模块从视觉语言特性中提取出物理符号,以条件生成动作而无需在线视频生成. 该模块通过直接预测未来的RGB,深度和光学流出特征来学习,并通过被冷冻的预训视频世界模型进行辅助监督. 培训完全依靠公开提供的数据,通过人对机器人的合成、子任务注释和体现的思想链注释加以扩展。 在四个模拟基准中,PDRVLA在LIBERO上的成功率为99.3%,在LIBERO-Plus上的成功率为89.9%,在RoboTwin~2.0上的成功率为93.6%,在SimmerEnv上的成功率为81.5%。 校对显示未来对世界模型监督的预测有所改进,并评估子任务配置、未来对对象的监管以及ECoT培训如何影响行动的成功。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–Language–Action (VLA) models connect visual observations and language instructions to robot control, drawing on pretrained vision–language models (VLMs) and demonstrations from heterogeneous robots ( Black et al., 2024 ; Physical Intelligence, 2025 ) . Their understanding of the physical world, however, remains limited. For example, a recent analysis reports weak encoding of object physical properties across several VLA policies and unreliable adaptation of their motions to changes in object mass ( Xu, 2026 ) . For manipulation, recognizing the current scene is only part of the problem: grasping, moving, and placing objects also change their configurations and spatial relationships. Anticipating how a scene evolves during interaction can provide useful context for action selection, motivating representations that connect current observations with future appearance, geometry, and motion.
blocks.zh: Vision–Language–Action(VLA)模型将视觉观测和语言指令连接到机器人控制上,借鉴了经过预先训练的视觉–语言模型(VLM)和不同机器人的演示(Black等人,2024年;物理智能,2025年). 然而,他们对物理世界的了解仍然有限。 例如,最近一项分析报告说,若干VLA政策对物体物理属性的编码薄弱,而且其运动不可靠地适应物体质量的变化(Xu, 2026)。 对于操控,识别当前场景只是问题的一部分: 把握,移动,放置物体也改变它们的配置和空间关系. 设想一个场景在互动过程中如何演变,可以为选择动作提供有用的背景,激发将当前观测与未来外观,几何和运动联系起来的表达.

blocks.en: Pretrained video world models offer a complementary way to learn physical dynamics by predicting how scenes change over time ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) . Incorporating these models into robot policies can connect future prediction with action generation ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . However, generating future videos within the control loop adds latency to action generation. Recent approaches instead use video prediction during training to shape compact representations that can condition a policy without online video generation ( InternRobotics, 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视频世界模型通过预测场景随着时间的变化提供了学习物理动态的一种补充方式(Team Wan等人,2025年). 把这些模型纳入机器人政策可以将未来的预测与动作生成联系起来(Kim等人,2026年). 然而,在控制循环中生成未来的视频会给动作生成增加耐久性. 近期的做法相反是,在培训期间使用视频预测来形成紧凑的表述,这种表述可以附带一项政策而无需在线视频生成(InternRobotics,2026;Tang等人,2026)。

blocks.en: Following this direction, we introduce PDRVLA, a VLA model with a lightweight Physical Dynamics Module (Figure 1 ). The module extracts a fixed set of physical tokens from intermediate VLM features. The action expert uses these tokens alongside the final-layer VLM features to generate actions. We train the module with two complementary objectives. Direct supervision uses future RGB, depth, and optical-flow latent features as targets, encouraging the tokens to encode future appearance, geometry, and motion. A frozen pretrained video world model conditioned on the physical tokens provides auxiliary supervision for temporal prediction. Joint policy training then combines action and vision–language (VL) objectives with continued direct future prediction. The resulting policy uses physical tokens for action generation without running the video model during control.
blocks.zh: 按照这个方向,我们引入了PDRVLA,一个具有轻量级物理动力学模块(图1)的VLA模型. 该模块从中间VLM特征中提取了一组固定的物理符号. 动作专家使用这些符号与最终的VLM特性一起生成动作. 我们培训模块有两个互补的目标。 直接监督将未来的RGB、深度和光学流潜伏特征作为目标,鼓励符号编码未来的外观、几何和运动。 以物理信使为条件的冷冻预导视频世界模型为时间预测提供了辅助监督. 然后,联合政策培训将行动和远景-语言目标与未来的直接预测结合起来。 由此产生的政策是在控制期间不运行视频模型的情况下使用物理符号进行动作生成.

blocks.en: Our training corpus is built entirely from publicly available datasets. It combines real-robot, handheld UMI, and simulated trajectories with general and robotics-oriented VL data, and is expanded through egocentric human-to-robot synthesis. Subtask and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotations provide additional supervision for task stages, scene understanding, progress assessment, and next motion. Together, these sources support training across heterogeneous embodiments and complementary forms of action and language supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练大纲完全来自公开的数据集。 它结合了真机器人,手持UMI,以及模拟轨迹与一般和面向机器人的VL数据,并通过以自我为中心的人对机器人合成得到扩展. 次级任务和包含的思想链(ECoT)说明为任务阶段、场景理解、进展评估和下一步行动提供了额外的监督。 这些来源共同支持各种表现形式的培训以及辅助行动形式和语言监督。

blocks.en: We evaluate PDRVLA on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , and SimplerEnv ( Li et al., 2024 ) , achieving success rates of 99.3%, 89.9%, 93.6%, and 81.5%, respectively. Ablation studies show that world-model-assisted supervision improves future prediction. Additional experiments examine the effects of subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT annotations on policy performance.
blocks.zh: 我们对LIBERO(Liu等人,2023年),LIBERO-Plus(Fei等人,2025年),RoboTwin 2.0(Chen等人,2025年a)和SimmerEnv(Li等人,2024年)的评价,成功率分别为99.3%、89.9%、93.6%和81.5%。 校对研究表明,世界模型辅助监督可以改善未来的预测. 更多的实验考察了子任务调节,未来对象拥有物监督,以及ECoT对政策性能的说明的效果.

blocks.en: The report makes three contributions: • We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts compact physical tokens from intermediate VLM features to complement the final-layer features used for action generation. We train these representations through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision from a frozen video world model. Direct future prediction continues during joint policy training, while deployment uses the learned physical tokens without running the video generator. • We assemble a cross-embodiment training corpus entirely from publicly available datasets, integrating real-robot, handheld UMI, and simulated demonstrations with general and robotics-oriented VL data. Our data pipeline standardizes heterogeneous trajectories, expands embodiment coverage through egocentric human-to-robot synthesis, and adds subtask and ECoT annotations, supporting joint learning of robot actions and language responses about task stages, scene context, progress, and next motion. • We evaluate PDRVLA on four simulation benchmarks and conduct targeted analyses of physical-representation learning and policy performance. The results show improved future prediction with world-model assistance and characterize the effects of subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT annotations on action success across tasks and inference settings.
blocks.zh: 报告提出了三项意见: 我们引入了PDRVLA,其轻量级物理动力模块从中间VLM特性中提取了紧凑的物理符号,以补充用于动作生成的终层特性. 我们通过直接预测未来的RGB,深度和光学流的特性来训练这些表达方式,辅以冷冻的视频世界模型的监督. 在联合政策培训期间继续进行直接的未来预测,而部署则使用学到的实物符号,而不运行视频生成器。 我们完全从公开的数据集组装一个跨化的训练仪器,将真机器人、手持UMI和模拟演示与一般和面向机器人的VL数据结合起来。 我们的数据管道将各种轨迹标准化,通过以自我为中心的人对机器人合成来扩大浮雕的覆盖范围,并增加子任务和ECoT说明,支持联合学习机器人动作和语言对任务阶段、场景背景、进展和下一个动作的反应。 我们对PDRVLA进行四项模拟基准评估,并对实际表现的学习和政策业绩进行有针对性的分析。 结果表明,通过世界模式的协助,未来预测有所改善,并说明了次级任务调节、未来对象拥有权监督以及ECoT关于跨任务和推论环境的行动成功的说明的效果。

blocks.en: 2 Data
blocks.zh: 2 数据

blocks.en: 2.1 Corpus Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 公司概况

blocks.en: Our training corpus combines VLA data with VL data. The VLA portion pairs observations and task instructions with control targets, grounding the model in robot behavior across diverse embodiments and environments. The VL portion extends perceptual, spatial, and task-level reasoning beyond the coverage of action trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练大纲把VLA数据与VL数据结合起来. VLA部分将观测和任务指令与控制目标对齐,将模型植根于机器人行为中,跨越不同的浮雕和环境. VL部分扩展了感知,空间,任务层次的推理,超出了动作轨迹的覆盖范围.

blocks.en: We organize the corpus into five categories. The VLA portion comprises real-robot trajectories, UMI demonstrations, and simulated interactions, which provide complementary trade-offs in physical fidelity, collection cost, embodiment coverage, and scale. The VL portion comprises general image- and video-language data together with spatial and embodied examples more closely aligned with manipulation. Table 1 summarizes the composition and scale of each category; individual sources are described in Sections 2.2 and 2.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们把尸体分成五类 VLA部分包括真机器人轨迹、UMI演示和模拟互动,在身体忠贞性、收集成本、浮雕覆盖和规模方面提供互补的权衡。 VL部分包括一般图像和视频语言数据以及空间数据,并包含与操纵更紧密配合的实例。 表1概述了每一类别的组成和规模;第2.2节和第2.3节叙述了个别来源。

blocks.en: In addition to aggregating existing datasets, we derive new training data through synthesis and annotation. Egocentric human-to-robot synthesis converts EgoDex demonstrations ( Hoque et al., 2026 ) into visually and kinematically adapted trajectories for multiple robot embodiments. Subtask annotation assigns a stage label to each frame and produces subtask-prediction VL examples, while ECoT annotation produces keyframe-level VL examples describing the scene, task progress, and next motion. Table 2 summarizes these derived data.
blocks.zh: 除了汇总现有数据集外,我们还通过综合和注释获得新的培训数据。 Egocent人对机器人合成将EgoDex演示(Hoque等人,2026年)转化为视觉和动能适应的轨道,用于多个机器人的浮雕. 子任务注释为每个帧指定一个级标签,并生成子任务预测VL实例,而ECoT注释则生成密钥帧级VL实例,描述场景,任务进度,以及下一个动作. 表2概述了这些衍生数据。

blocks.en: 2.2 VLA Data
blocks.zh: 2.2 志愿军 数据

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Real-Robot Data
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 实际机器人数据

blocks.en: Real-robot trajectories expose the model to real-world dynamics, sensor variation, and contact-rich interactions. We aggregate public datasets spanning different robots, environments, and task families.
blocks.zh: 真机器人轨迹将模型暴露在现实世界动态,传感器变异,接触丰富的相互作用中. 我们汇集了涵盖不同机器人、环境和任务家庭的公共数据集。

blocks.en: Our single-arm tabletop and in-the-wild manipulation data come from RoboSet ( Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ) , DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) , BridgeData V2 ( Walke et al., 2023 ) , BC-Z ( Jang et al., 2022 ) , and RH20T ( Fang et al., 2024 ) . Together, they cover diverse scenes, objects, operators, and manipulation skills, including pick-and-place, articulated-object interaction, and tool use.
blocks.zh: 我们的单臂平板电脑和无线操纵数据来自RoboSet(Bharadhwaj等人,2024年),DROID(Khazatsky等人,2024年),Bridge。 数据V2(Walke等人,2023年),BC-Z(Jang等人,2022年),RH20T(Fang等人,2024年). 它们共同涵盖各种场景、物体、操作员和操纵技能,包括采摘和放置、清晰的物体互动和工具使用。

blocks.en: We extend the embodiment coverage with bimanual and multi-platform data from RoboMIND V1/V2 ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Hou et al., 2025 ) , RoboCOIN ( Wu et al., 2025b ) , and ABC-130K ( Allshire et al., 2026 ) ; humanoid, arm, and dexterous-hand data from Humanoid Everyday ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) and the Unitree UniFoLM releases ( Unitree Robotics, 2026a ; Unitree Robotics, 2026b ; Unitree Robotics, 2026c ; Unitree Robotics, 2026d ; Unitree Robotics, 2026e ; Unitree Robotics, 2026f ) ; and large-scale multi-robot data from AgiBot World Colosseo ( Bu et al., 2025 ; AgiBot World Colosseum contributors, 2024 ; AgiBot World Team, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们利用RoboMIND V1/V2(Wu等人,2025年a)提供的双平台和多平台数据,扩大了该模型的覆盖范围; Hou等人,2025年),RoboCOIN(Wu等人,2025年b)和ABC-130K(Allshire等人,2026年b),人文、臂部和手部数据来自Humanoid每天(Zhao等人,2026年a)和Unitree UnitFoLM发布(Unitree Robotics,2026年a;Unitree Robotics,2026c;Unitree Robotics,2026d;Unitree Robotics,2026e;Unitree Robotics,2026f;以及AgiBot World Colosseo(Bu等人,2025年a);AgiBot World Colosseum贡献者2024;AgiBot World Team,2026年bot世界团队)的大规模多机器人数据。

blocks.en: REASSEMBLE ( Sliwowski et al., 2025 ) contributes contact-rich assembly and disassembly trajectories, while FuSe ( Jones et al., 2025 ) and MolmoAct ( Lee et al., 2025 ) provide additional manipulation trajectories.

blocks.en: Selected embodiment-specific subsets from the LeRobot community collections ( HuggingFaceVLA Community, 2025a ; HuggingFaceVLA Community, 2025b ; HuggingFaceVLA Community, 2025c ) add further cross-institution and cross-embodiment coverage.

blocks.en: 2.2.2 UMI Data
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 军事情报 数据

blocks.en: UMI data are collected with a handheld gripper and wrist-mounted camera rather than by teleoperating a particular robot ( Chi et al., 2024 ) . The resulting demonstrations record real-world interaction as camera observations and end-effector pose trajectories without tying the motion to a robot’s joint configuration.
blocks.zh: UMI数据是用手持式抓取器和手腕挂相机收集的,而不是通过远程操作某个特定的机器人来收集(Chi等人,2024年). 将真实世界的相互作用记录为相机观测和终端效应器,

blocks.en: We use six UMI datasets with different scales, capture systems, and task coverage: UMI ( Chi et al., 2024 ) , FastUMI ( Zhaxizhuoma et al., 2025 ) , FastUMI-100K ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA-Data ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , HiFi-UMI-2K ( Simple AI et al., 2026 ) , and RealOmni-Open Data ( GenRobot.AI (2025), Jianzhi Robotics ) . After source-specific filtering, they contribute approximately 1.22 million episodes and 10,259 hours.

blocks.en: Because UMI demonstrations do not provide robot joint-space commands, we use their temporally aligned end-effector poses directly to construct the unified Cartesian action representation in Section 2.4 .
blocks.zh: 由于UMI演示不提供机器人联合空间指令,我们使用它们的时间对齐的终端效应器直接在2.4节构建统一的笛卡尔动作代表.

blocks.en: 2.2.3 Simulation Data
blocks.zh: 2.2.3 模拟数据

blocks.en: Simulation complements real-world data with controllable, reproducible interaction and access to ground-truth states and success signals. It also makes it practical to vary tasks and embodiments without additional hardware collection.
blocks.zh: 模拟用可控、可复制的相互作用以及地面真实状态和成功信号的存取来补充现实世界的数据。 这也使得在不增加硬件收藏的情况下改变任务和化身变得实用.

blocks.en: The simulation corpus covers three complementary settings: standardized skills and long-horizon tasks from ManiSkill2 ( Gu et al., 2023 ) , Meta-World ( Yu et al., 2019 ) , and RoboCasa ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) ; large-scale cross-embodiment trajectories from InternData-A1 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) , GR00T-X-Embodiment-Sim ( NVIDIA, 2025a ) , and InternVLA-M1 ( Chen et al., 2025b ) ; and bimanual or dexterous manipulation from RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025a ) and DexMimicGen ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 模拟程序包括三个互补的设置:ManiSkill2(Gu等人,2023年),Meta-World(Yu等人,2019年)和RoboCasa(Nasiriany等人,2024年)的标准化技能和长距离任务;InternData-A1(Tian等人,2026年)的大规模交叉化轨迹;GR00T-X-Embodiment-Sim(NVIDIA,2025a年)和InternVLA-M1(Chen等人,2025b年);RoboTwin 2.0(Chen等人,2025a年)和DexMimicGen(Jiang等人,2025年)的双人或非人操纵。

blocks.en: The general VL mixture includes vision-centric instruction data from Cambrian-1 ( Tong et al., 2024 ) ; captioning and open-ended visual question answering from COCO-Caption ( LMMs-Lab, 2026 ) and VQAv2 ( HuggingFaceM4, 2026 ) ; and image- and video-reasoning examples from OneThinker ( Feng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 一般VL混合物包括来自Cambrian-1(Tong等人,2024年)的以视觉为中心的指令数据;来自COCO-Caption(LMMs-Lab,2026年)和VQAv2(HuggingFaceM4,2026年)的字幕和开放式视觉问题回答;以及来自OneThinker(冯等人,2025年)的图像和视频推理实例。

blocks.en: 2.3.2 Spatial and Embodied VL Data
blocks.zh: 2.3.2 空间和物理VL数据

blocks.en: Spatial and embodied VL data bring the supervision closer to manipulation. We divide them into spatial reasoning over general imagery and embodied or procedural reasoning drawn from robot data, simulation, and web video.
blocks.zh: 空间和包含的VL数据使监督更接近于操纵。 我们把它们分为一般图像的空间推理和从机器人数据、模拟和网络视频中提取的体现或程序推理。

blocks.en: The spatial-reasoning group covers spatial question answering, geometric relations, coordinate-aware grounding, referring-expression localization, and multi-view or 3D reasoning. It includes SpaceThinker ( Remyx AI, 2026a ) , OpenSpaces ( Remyx AI, 2026b ) , SpaceOm ( Remyx AI, 2026c ) , RefSpatial ( An, 2026 ) , data released with Scaling Spatial Intelligence with Multimodal Foundation Models ( Cai et al., 2026a ) , and cross-view correspondence examples linking egocentric, third-person, and robot-camera observations ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 空间推理组包括空间问题回答,几何关系,协调意识地面,参考表达本地化,以及多视图或3D推理. 它包括SpaceThinker(Remyx AI, 2026a),OpenSpaces(Remyx AI, 2026b),SpaceOm(Remyx AI, 2026c),Respatial(An, 2026),与多模式基金会模型(Cai 等人, 2026a)一起发布的空间情报扩展数据,以及连接自我中心,第三人和机器人相机观测的交叉视图通信实例. (王等,2025年) (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: The embodied and procedural group includes point supervision for object, free-space, and affordance localization from RoboPoint ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) ; visual question answering and long-horizon reasoning over manipulation videos from Robo2VLM ( Chen et al., 2025c ) and RoboVQA ( Sermanet et al., 2024 ) ; interleaved perception and reasoning from EO-1 ( Qu et al., 2025 ) ; physical-commonsense supervision from Cosmos-Reason1 ( NVIDIA, 2025b ) ; and web-derived procedural supervision for step decomposition and progress reasoning from ProcCorpus-60M ( Feng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 包含的程序组包括:RoboPoint(袁等人,2024年)对物体、空闲空间和支付力本地化的点监督;Robo2VLM(陈等人,2025年c)和RoboVQA(Sermanet等人,2024年)对操纵视频的视觉问题回答和长距离推理;EO-1(Qu等人,2025年)对认知和推理的相互分离;Cosmos-Reason1(NVIDIA,2025b)对物理常识的监督;ProcCorpus-60M对步骤分解和进度推理的网络程序监督。 (冯等,2026).

blocks.en: 2.4 Data Processing
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 数据处理

blocks.en: Trajectories from different datasets vary in action format, coordinate conventions, hardware names, and video configuration. We standardize action representations, filter invalid trajectories and frames, unify embodiment metadata, and align and encode visual observations. Processing rules account for differences in hardware and collection procedures.
blocks.zh: 不同数据集的轨迹在动作格式,协调会议,硬件名称和视频配置方面各不相同. 我们把动作表达方式标准化,过滤无效的轨迹和框架,统一表征元数据,并对视觉观测进行对齐和编码。 处理规则反映了硬件和收集程序的差异.

blocks.en: To standardize end-effector (EEF) poses across datasets, we convert positions to meters and orientations to rotation matrices, and normalize the coordinate axes to a right-handed convention with + x +x forward, + y +y left, and + z +z up. Each manipulator’s poses remain relative to the arm base or the world frame, as specified by the source dataset. We express its current and target poses in the same reference frame and record that frame in the metadata.
blocks.zh: 为使终端效应器(EEF)跨数据集实现标准化,我们把位置转换为米,方向转换为旋转矩阵,并将坐标轴正常化为右手公约,其中+x+x向前,+y+y左,+z+z向上. 按照源数据集的规定,每个操纵者的姿势仍然相对于臂基或世界框架。 我们用同样的参考框架表达其当前和目标,并在元数据中记录这一框架。

blocks.en: For grippers with opening measurements, we normalize the current and target openings to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] using the gripper’s physical travel range, with 0 denoting fully closed and 1 fully open. The gripper action is the normalized absolute target opening.
blocks.zh: 对于有开口测量的抓取器,我们利用抓取器的物理旅行范围,将电流和目标开口正常化为[0, 1] [0, 1],其中0号完全关闭, 1号完全开放. 控制器是正常的绝对目标打开

blocks.en: We reject entire episodes that are too short, lack usable action targets or state sequences, contain values whose units cannot be recovered, or have image and state streams that cannot be aligned. We also reject episodes whose task descriptions conflict with the source metadata. Filtering thresholds are set separately for each dataset or subset to account for differences in hardware and collection procedures.
blocks.zh: 我们拒绝整个事件,因为这些事件太短,缺乏可用的行动目标或状态序列,包含其单位无法恢复的值,或图像和状态流无法对齐. 我们也拒绝那些任务描述与源元数据相冲突的事件. 过滤阈值为每个数据集或子集分别设置,以计入硬件和收集程序的差异.

blocks.en: For otherwise usable episodes, frames containing non-finite values, abnormal repeated observations, abrupt spikes, or out-of-range values are excluded from supervision but retained at their original temporal positions to preserve image–state–action alignment. If the corruption cannot be isolated to individual frames, we reject the entire episode.
blocks.zh: 对于其他可用的事件,包含非无限值、反常的重复观测、突如其来的突起或超距离值的帧被排除在监管之外,但保留在原来的时间位置上,以维护图像-状态-动作对齐。 如果腐败不能孤立于个别框架,我们反对整个事件。

blocks.en: Robot hardware names vary across datasets, and the same arm can be paired with different grippers or dexterous hands. We record robot, arm, and end-effector types separately in robot_type , arm_type , and hand_type . We standardize aliases such as panda and franka_panda to a common arm name while retaining the identity of the attached end effector. Missing or inconsistent metadata are checked against source documentation and recorded images or videos.
blocks.zh: 机器人的硬件名称因数据集而异,同一臂可以与不同的抓手或dexterous的手对齐. 我们分别记录机器人,手臂,和终端效器类型 在机器人_类型,手臂_类型,和手_类型。 我们把小熊猫和Franda_panda等别名标准化为普通臂名,同时保留附着的终端效应器的身份. 对缺失或不一致的元数据进行对照源文件和录制的图像或视频检查。

blocks.en: Camera observations and robot states may be recorded at different rates. We align them at the lowest rate among the streams, capped at 30 Hz. At most four camera views are retained per episode, prioritizing wrist and third-person views, with view selection configured for each dataset. The selected videos are resized to 640 pixels on the longest side and encoded with a maximum group-of-pictures (GOP) size of 2 frames to accelerate random frame access. Post-processing checks verify that video frames remain aligned with robot states and actions.
blocks.zh: 相机观测和机器人状态可能以不同的速度记录. 我们以最低的速度在河流中调整它们,上限为30赫兹。 每集最多保留4个镜头视图,优先排列手腕和第三人称视图,为每个数据集配置视图选择. 所选的视频在最长的侧面被调整为640像素,并编码为2帧的最大组图(GOP)尺寸,以加速随机帧访问. 处理后检查核实视频帧仍与机器人状态和行动保持一致.

blocks.en: 2.5 Data Synthesis and Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.5 数据综合和注释

blocks.en: We expand the training corpus through human-to-robot synthesis and language annotation. The former adapts egocentric demonstrations into robot observations and actions; the latter adds subtask labels and ECoT descriptions of the scene, task progress, and next motion to existing trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们通过人对机器人的合成和语言注释来扩充训练大纲. 前者将自我中心化的演示改编成机器人的观测和行动;后者则将子任务标签和ECoT的场景描述,任务进度,以及接下来的动作添加到现有的轨迹中.

blocks.en: 2.5.1 Egocentric Human-to-Robot Synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.5.1 以人为中心对机器人的综合

blocks.en: Human egocentric data cover diverse real-world scenes and manipulation tasks, but human hands and arms differ from robot manipulators in both appearance and kinematics. We therefore adapt both the recorded motion and the visual observations before using these demonstrations for VLA training.
blocks.zh: 以人类自负为中心的数据涵盖了不同的现实世界场景和操纵任务,但人的手和手臂在外观和动能上都与机器人操纵者不同. 因此,在使用这些示威进行志愿军培训之前,我们先调整记录在案的动议和视觉观察。

blocks.en: We apply the human-to-robot synthesis pipeline of Qwen-RobotManip ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) to EgoDex ( Hoque et al., 2026 ) , generating demonstrations for 12 robot-arm models: Panda, UR5e, UR10e, FR3, Kinova Gen3, IIWA, ARX-L5, xArm7, ViperX, WidowX, Piper, and YAM.
blocks.zh: 我们把Quen-RobotManip(袁等人,2026年)的人对机器人合成管道应用于EgoDex(Hoque等人,2026年),为12个机器人武器模型产生演示: 熊猫,UR5e,UR10e,FR3,Kinova Gen3,IIWA,ARX-L5,xArm7,毒蛇,寡妇X,Piper,和YAM.

blocks.en: We map EgoDex’s per-frame 3D hand keypoints to an end-effector (EEF) pose trajectory and gripper commands. The EEF trajectory is mapped into each target robot’s coordinate system, and inverse kinematics (IK) produces the corresponding arm-joint trajectory. We discard demonstrations with too few high-confidence hand keypoints and retargeted trajectories whose EEF poses, computed through forward kinematics, deviate excessively from the desired poses.
blocks.zh: 我们将 EgoDex 的每帧 3D 手键点映射到一个末端效果器( EEF) 的轨道和抓取命令 。 EEF轨迹被映射到每个目标机器人的坐标系统中,反动脉学(IK)产生相应的臂联轨迹. 我们放弃了高度自信的手键点太少的示威和重新瞄准的轨迹,这些轨迹通过前向运动器计算,过度偏离了期望的姿势。

blocks.en: We segment the human hands and arms with SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) and use ProPainter ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) to reconstruct the background in the masked regions across the video. We render the target robot arm and gripper using the retargeted motion, then composite them into the reconstructed video. DA3 depth estimates ( Lin et al., 2025 ) determine which scene surfaces occlude the rendered robot during compositing. The resulting videos, arm-joint trajectories, and gripper commands form the synthetic VLA examples.
blocks.zh: 我们用SAM3(Carion等人,2026年)将人类的手和手臂分割开来,并利用ProPainter(Zhou等人,2023年)在全视频的蒙面地区重建背景. 我们用重定向运动使目标机器人手臂和抓手,然后把它们合成重建的视频。 DA3深度估计(Lin等人,2025年)确定哪个场景表面在堆肥过程中吞噬了制成的机器人. 由此产生的视频,臂联轨迹,以及抓手指令,构成了合成VLA的例子.

blocks.en: After filtering and standardization, the synthesized corpus contains 896,832 bimanual robot trajectories, totaling approximately 2,646 hours. These trajectories derive from 74,813 distinct EgoDex demonstrations, each of which may contribute variants for multiple target robots. Because the robot variants share a common source pool, the resulting datasets have similar sizes across robot models, with approximately 74,000–75,000 trajectories and 219–221 hours per target arm model.
blocks.zh: 经过过滤和标准化,合成体包含896,832个双人机器人轨迹,总计约2,646小时. 这些轨迹来源于74,813个截然不同的EgoDex演示,每个演示都可能会为多个目标机器人贡献变种. 由于机器人变体共享一个共同的源集合,因此所产生的数据集在机器人模型之间大小相似,每个目标臂模型的轨距约为74,000–75,000,219–221小时.

blocks.en: 2.5.2 Subtask Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.5.2 子任务说明

blocks.en: Long-horizon manipulation tasks contain stages with distinct intermediate goals. Following prior work on hierarchical task structure ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) , we segment trajectories into ordered subtasks and assign a subtask label to each frame. These annotations yield both subtask-annotated VLA trajectories and VL examples about task stages and transitions.
blocks.zh: 长视距操纵任务包含具有明显中间目标的阶段. 继先前关于分级任务结构的工作(Zhang等人,2024年;Chen等人,2023年)之后,我们把轨迹分割成已订购的子任务,并为每个帧指定一个子任务标签. 这些说明产生了附加说明的VLA子任务轨迹和关于任务阶段和过渡的VL实例。

blocks.en: Source-provided subtask annotations are reused when available; the remaining trajectories are automatically annotated with Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) on sparsely sampled observations. We sample one frame per second and increase the sampling rate for short trajectories to provide more observations. Observations at each sampled timestamp come from a selected camera view, with multiple views spatially concatenated when needed, such as two wrist-camera views for bimanual interactions.
blocks.zh: 来源提供的子任务说明在可用时会重复使用;其余的轨迹则在少量样本观测上自动附加Qwen3.8-27B(Quen Team,2026a). 我们每秒取样一个框架,提高短轨的取样率,以提供更多的观测。 每个取样时间戳的观测都来自一个选定的相机视图,在需要时会空间化地进行多个视图,例如两个手腕-相机视图用于双人互动.

blocks.en: The sampled observations are divided into sliding windows of at most 128 frames with a 16-frame overlap. For each window, the model predicts subtask descriptions and segment boundaries. For each sampled frame in an overlap, we use the prediction from the window whose midpoint is closest to that frame. We merge these predictions into an episode-level segmentation and propagate the segment labels to every frame, producing subtask-annotated VLA trajectories. Frames after the last predicted boundary receive a done label indicating the end of the annotated sequence.
blocks.zh: 抽样观测分为最多128帧、16帧重叠的滑动窗口。 对于每个窗口,模型预测子任务描述和段边界. 对于每个重叠的抽样框架,我们使用窗口的预测,其中点最接近该框架。 我们把这些预测合并成一个插曲级的分片,并将分片的标签传播到每个帧,产生子任务附加说明的VLA轨迹. 最后一个预测边界后的框架收到一个已完成的标签,表示注释序列的结束。

blocks.en: Following π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Physical Intelligence, 2025 ) , we further convert these annotations into VL examples that ask the model to identify the current subtask from a visual observation and the episode-level instruction. Additional queries ask for the next subtask, the remaining subtask sequence, or whether the current segment has reached its annotated end. Figure 2 summarizes six variants that differ in query time and in whether prior subtask history is included.
blocks.zh: 在 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}(物理智能,2025年)之后,我们进一步将这些注释转换成VL实例,要求模型从视觉观察和插曲级指令中识别当前子任务. 其他查询则询问下一个子任务,剩余子任务序列,或者当前部分是否已达到附加说明的结束. 图2概括了在查询时间和是否包括先前的子任务历史上有所不同的六个变体.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Six types of subtask VL examples, differing in query timing, answer content, and subtask-history context. No observations after the query frame are provided.
blocks.zh: 图2: 六类子任务 VL 实例,在查询时间,答题内容,以及子任务-历史背景上的差异. 查询框架之后不提供观察。

blocks.en: Overall, subtask annotation covers approximately 1.88 million episodes, 1.79 billion frames, and 20,101 hours. Automatic subtask annotation processes 78 million sampled frames (4.4% of the total). From approximately 294,000 of the annotated episodes, we construct 1.1 million single-turn VL examples across 22 data families. Table 3 reports the source composition of the VL corpus.

blocks.zh: 表3:按来源组分列的VL子任务实例。 原生表示源提供的子任务标签 。

blocks.en: 2.5.3 ECoT Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.5.3 ECoT说明

blocks.en: Subtask labels identify the current intermediate goal but provide limited detail about the scene, task progress, and the motion that follows. We therefore augment the segmented trajectories in Section 2.5.2 with ECoT annotations ( Zawalski et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) that connect each subtask to its visual context and subsequent motion. Following Qwen-RobotManip ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , we annotate selected keyframes with scene descriptions, progress assessments, and next-motion descriptions derived from recorded poses.
blocks.zh: 子任务标签可以识别当前中间目标,但可以提供有限的场景细节,任务进展,以及随后的动作. 因此,我们用ECoT说明(Zawalski等人,2024年;Feng等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年)来扩充第2.5.2节中的条形轨迹,将每个子任务与其视觉背景和随后的运动联系起来。 继Quen-RobotManip(Yuan等人,2026年)之后,我们用场景描述、进度评估以及从记录的姿势中得出的下一个动作描述来注释选定的键框。

blocks.en: Keyframes are drawn only from frames marked valid during data processing (Section 2.4 ). Within each subtask, we retain its first and last valid frame and select additional frames when their visual similarity to the previous keyframe falls below a threshold. We compute image hashes with the Python ImageHash library 1 1 1 https://github.com/JohannesBuchner/imagehash to measure this similarity.
blocks.zh: 关键框架只取自数据处理期间有效的标记框架(第2.4节)。 在每一个子任务中,我们保留它的第一个和最后一个有效的框架,并在它们与前一个密钥框架的视觉相似性低于阈值时选择额外的框架. 我们用 Python ImageHash 库计算图像散列 11 1 https://github.com/JohannesBuchner/imagehash 来测量这种相似性。

blocks.en: For each keyframe, Qwen3.8-27B describes task-relevant objects, spatial relations, and gripper state, and assesses whether the active subtask is complete. To account for earlier events, we uniformly sample frames between the episode’s first frame and the current keyframe. Qwen3.8-27B uses these observations to generate a textual memory summary of gripper motion, object motion, and state changes. The model then uses the summary and the current frame to assess progress and explain its assessment. The summary is used during annotation and omitted from the training input.
blocks.zh: 对于每个密钥框架,Quen3.8-27B描述与任务相关的对象,空间关系,和抓取状态,并评估活动子任务是否完整. 为了说明早先的事件,我们统一了该集第一帧和当前关键帧之间的抽样框架。 Qune3.8-27B利用这些观测结果生成了抓取运动,物体运动,和状态变化的文字内存摘要. 该模型然后利用摘要和现行框架评估进展情况并解释其评估。 摘要在注释时使用,在培训投入中省略。

blocks.en: Where recorded EEF poses are available, we derive the next-motion description by comparing the EEF poses and gripper openings at the current keyframe and 0.5 seconds later. We ignore translation, rotation, and opening changes below their respective thresholds and map the remaining changes to directional phrases describing EEF motion and gripper opening or closing. These phrases are combined into a sentence such as “ The gripper moves forward, tilts down, and rotates clockwise. ”
blocks.zh: 在有记录的EEF外形的情况下,我们通过比较EEF外形和抓取器在目前键框上的开口以及0.5秒之后的开口来得出下一个动作描述. 我们忽略了翻译、旋转和打开低于各自阈值的更改,并绘制了描述EEF运动和抓取器打开或关闭方向短语的其余更改。 这些短语合并成一句,如“抓手向前移动、向下倾斜、顺时针旋转。 “

The annotations yield both ECoT-annotated VLA trajectories and VL examples whose targets contain the scene description, progress assessment, and, where available, next-motion description. We additionally use the released annotations from ProcCorpus-60M ( Feng et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: 3 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 3 示范建筑

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , PDRVLA consists of a Qwen3.5-4B VLM backbone ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , the Physical Dynamics Module, and an action expert. Given visual observations and a task instruction, the backbone provides intermediate features to the physical module, which produces a fixed-length sequence of physical tokens. The action expert combines these tokens with the final-layer VLM features and the current proprioceptive state to generate a chunk of robot commands.

Starting from Gaussian noise, Euler updates integrate predicted velocities into an action chunk. blocks.en: 3.1 Input Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 投入建筑

blocks.en: The VLM input is a single user message containing the current camera views followed by the task text, formatted with Qwen3.5’s native chat template. Views follow the order specified in each dataset’s camera configuration. We prefix the task instruction with the robot embodiment, arm and end-effector types, and control frequency when available, using the format embodiment <robot>, arm <arm>, hand <hand>. control <rate> Hz. <instruction> . For action generation with or without subtask conditioning, we use the VLM features directly without appending an assistant-generation prefix. The current proprioceptive state is supplied separately to the action expert.
blocks.zh: VLM 输入是包含当前相机视图的单一用户信息,随后是任务文本,格式化为Quen3.5的本地聊天模板. 视图遵循每个数据集相机配置中指定的顺序 。 我们在任务指示前加上机器人的化身、臂和末端效应类型,以及可用时的控制频率,使用格式化的化身 "robot " 、臂 " arm " 、手 " hand " 。 对于具有或没有子任务配置的动作生成,我们直接使用VLM特性,而不附加一个助理生成前缀. 目前自主状态单独提供给动作专家.

blocks.en: Subtask descriptions can be appended to the task instruction as Current step: <subtask> . During training, this text comes from the trajectory annotations. At inference, PDRVLA can first generate a subtask description from the current observations and task instruction, then append it to the instruction for the action-conditioning pass. Without subtask conditioning, the policy generates actions directly from the current observations and original task instruction, together with the robot state.
blocks.zh: 子任务描述可作为当前步骤附于任务指令: < subtask > 。 在训练期间,这个文本来自轨迹说明. 推论,PDRVLA首先可以从当前观测和任务指令中生成一个子任务描述,然后将其附加到用于动作调制通道的指令中. 没有子任务调制,政策直接从当前观测和原始任务指令中生成动作,连同机器人状态.

blocks.en: For ECoT-conditioned action generation, the VLM first generates a response describing the scene, task progress, and next motion, which provides additional context to the action expert.
blocks.zh: 对于ECoT有条件的动作生成,VLM首先生成一个描述场景的响应,任务进展,以及下一个动作,为动作专家提供了额外的上下文.

blocks.en: 3.2 Physical Dynamics Module
blocks.zh: 3.2 物理动力模块

blocks.en: Later VLM layers may suppress visual information useful for predicting physical change. Layer-wise studies have found stronger perceptual representations at intermediate layers of large language models and a prominent role for these layers in accessing visual information ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Kaduri et al., 2025 ) . Motivated by these findings, at timestep t t , we use the VLM’s layer- l l features H t ( l ) H_{t}^{(l)} for the current multi-view observations and task instruction as input to the Physical Dynamics Module. In our implementation, l = 8 l=8 for a backbone with 32 decoder blocks. The action expert also uses the final-layer features from the same backbone pass.
blocks.zh: 后来的VLM层可能压制用于预测物理变化的视觉信息. 层层研究发现,大语言模型中间层的认知表现更强,这些层在获取视觉信息方面发挥显著作用(Jain等人,2025年;Kaduri等人,2025年)。 基于这些发现,在时间步 t t, 我们使用 VLM 的层 - l 特征 H t ( l) H_{t}^{ (l) } 用于当前多视图观测和任务指令, 作为物理动态模块的输入 。 在我们的实施中,l=8l=8 一个有32个解码块的骨干. 动作专家还使用同一主干通道的终极功能.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 (b), the module uses 50 learnable queries to extract a fixed set of physical tokens C t C_{t} from H t ( l ) H_{t}^{(l)} . Across 4 Transformer blocks, the queries retrieve information from the VLM features through cross-attention, exchange information through self-attention, and pass through a feed-forward layer. Each block has a hidden width of 1024, 4 attention heads, and a feed-forward expansion ratio of 1. A final projection maps the query outputs to the VLM hidden width, producing 50 physical tokens of width 2560. Future-prediction supervision trains the module to encode dynamics-related information in these tokens (Section 4.1 ), which are subsequently supplied to the action expert alongside the final-layer VLM features. The module adds approximately 57.3 57.3 M parameters ( 1.4 % 1.4\% of the 4B backbone).

blocks.en: Training a single policy across heterogeneous robots requires a common representation that accommodates different controller interfaces. We use a fixed-dimensional action vector with separate left and right manipulator slots. Each slot reserves dimensions for four component types: • arm-joint positions: 7 dimensions; • end-effector (EEF) pose: 9 reserved dimensions, of which 6 encode the action; • dexterous-hand joint positions: 12 dimensions; • gripper opening: 1 dimension. The two slots together form a 58-dimensional vector. The EEF slot shares its reserved width with the 9D proprioceptive pose representation; its action occupies the first 6 dimensions, with the remaining 3 padded and masked. EEF actions are expressed relative to the pose at the beginning of the chunk, while arm-joint positions, dexterous-hand joint positions, and gripper openings are absolute targets. Dimensions unsupported by an embodiment’s controller are padded and excluded from the training loss; execution uses only the supported components.

blocks.en: 4.1 Physical Dynamics Pretraining
blocks.zh: 4.1 物理动力学

blocks.en: We pretrain the Physical Dynamics Module (Section 3.2 ) to encode future appearance, geometry, and motion in its physical tokens. A direct prediction objective supervises these tokens using future RGB, depth, and optical-flow latent features. Because the module and its prediction head are trained from scratch, we also use a frozen pretrained video model to provide auxiliary supervision for representation learning.
blocks.zh: 我们预先训练物理动力模块(第3.2节),以编码未来外观、几何和运动的物理符号。 一个直接的预测目标利用未来的RGB,深度和光学流潜质来监督这些符号. 由于模块及其预测头部是从零开始训练的,我们也使用冷冻的预先训练的视频模型,为表现学习提供辅助监督.

blocks.en:
For physical pretraining, each example pairs the current observations and task instruction with a five-frame video sampled from a recorded clip spanning the current timestep and the following 30 action steps. The RGB frames provide appearance targets, while DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) and DPFlow ( Morimitsu et al., 2025 ) generate depth and optical-flow pseudo-labels for geometry and motion supervision. Following RynnWorld-4D ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) , depth values are clipped to a fixed range and mapped to grayscale intensities, while optical-flow fields are color-encoded to form the corresponding depth and flow videos.
We encode the three video targets into compact latent features rather than predicting them in pixel space. LingBot-Video’s frozen Wan video variational autoencoder (VAE) ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) provides these representations, and the same encoded targets are reused for direct prediction.
blocks.zh:
对于物理预训,每个实例将当前观察和任务指示与从当前时间步骤和以下30个行动步骤的录制片段中取样的五帧视频结合。 RGB帧提供外观目标,而DA3(Lin等人,2025年)和DPFlow(Morimitsu等人,2025年)则产生几何和运动监督的深度和光学流伪标签. 遵循RynnWorld-4D(Zhao et al., 2026b),深度值被剪切到一个固定范围,并映射到灰度强度,而光学流场则被色彩编码,形成相应的深度和流视频.
我们把三个视频目标编码成紧凑的潜在功能,而不是在像素空间中预测它们. 灵灵 Bot-Video的冷冻的Wan视频变异自编码器(VAE)(Team Wan等人,2025年)提供了这些表示,同样的编码目标被重新用于直接预测.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate PDRVLA on four simulation benchmarks covering single-arm and bimanual manipulation, robustness to observation and instruction perturbations, and WidowX manipulation under visual-matching settings. Performance is reported as task success rates and compared with published VLA baselines. Section 5.3 examines the effect of world-model-assisted pretraining on future prediction. Additional studies examine subtask conditioning and its update frequency, auxiliary future object-pose supervision, and ECoT supervision during training versus generation at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们评价PDRVLA的四个模拟基准,包括单臂和双手操控、强力观察和指令扰动以及视像比对下WibleX操控。 业绩报告为任务成功率,并与公布的志愿军基线进行比较。 第5.3节审查了世界模型辅助预训对未来预测的影响。 其他研究审查了子任务配置及其更新频率、辅助性未来对象拥有监督,以及ECOT在培训过程中对生成进行推断的监督。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: LIBERO Liu et al. (2023) evaluates single-arm manipulation across four suites: Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long, each containing 10 tasks. We fine-tune the pretrained policy jointly on LIBERO demonstrations from all four suites for 40,000 updates with a global batch size of 128. Adaptation uses dense valid starting frames rather than the frame-selection procedure used during policy pretraining. We evaluate 500 episodes per suite (2,000 in total) and report success rates for each suite and their average.
blocks.zh: 利比里亚 刘等. (2023年)评价单臂操控横跨空间,对象,目标,朗四个套房,每个套房包含10项任务. 我们对所有四个套房的LIBERO演示进行预先训练的政策进行微调,以4万个更新,全球批量128个。 适应措施采用密集有效的起始框架,而不是政策前培训中使用的框架选择程序。 我们评价每套500集(2 000集),并报告每套的成功率及其平均数。

blocks.en: Across the four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves the highest aggregate success rates among the compared methods, demonstrating strong manipulation performance and robustness under benchmark perturbations. Baseline results are drawn from the cited papers and official repositories under their respective training and evaluation protocols, including comparisons reported by InternVLA-A1.5 ( InternRobotics, 2026 ) and Qwen-RobotManip ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . blocks.en: 5.3 Component Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 构成部分分析

blocks.en: We first examine whether world-model supervision improves future-feature prediction, then study the use of subtask and ECoT annotations in action policies. An additional exploratory experiment tests object-pose prediction as auxiliary supervision. The policy studies use independent training setups and baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查世界模型监督是否改进了未来地貌预测,然后研究在行动政策中使用子任务和ECoT说明. 附加的探索性实验测试对象-pose预测作为辅助监督. 政策研究采用独立的培训设置和基线。

blocks.en: 5.3.1 Physical Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 体育代表学习

blocks.en: We examine whether supervision from a video world model improves the physical module’s ability to predict future features beyond direct supervision alone. We compare direct future-feature prediction with the same objective augmented by world-model-assisted flow matching. Both runs use the original Qwen3.5-4B backbone, equal training-sample budgets, and identical learning-rate and direct-loss-weight schedules. We compare their normalized RGB, depth, and optical-flow prediction errors before loss weighting, excluding the auxiliary world-model loss. Figure 5 shows that RGB and depth training errors decrease more rapidly early in training with world-model assistance. The two runs show a smaller gap in optical-flow error, and the gaps narrow later in training.
blocks.zh: 我们审查通过视频世界模型进行监督是否提高物理单元预测未来特征的能力,而不只是直接监督。 我们把直接的未来空间预测与世界模型辅助流量匹配所强化的同一目标进行比较。 两者都使用原有的Quen3.5-4B主干线,平等的培训抽样预算,以及相同的学习率和直接损失加权时间表. 我们比较了它们正常的RGB,深度,以及减重前的光学流预测错误,不包括辅助的世界模型损失. 图5显示,在提供世界模式援助的情况下,RGB和深度培训错误在培训中更快减少。 两次运行显示光学流误差较小,培训后期差距较小.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Normalized training MSE with direct prediction alone or additional world-model supervision. Each curve shows sample-weighted means over the preceding 1,000 updates; insets show updates 1,000–6,000 in greater detail.
blocks.zh: 图5:单凭直接预测或额外的世界模型监督,使MSE培训正常化。 每条曲线显示比前1 000次更新更经过抽样加权的表示;套件更详细地显示更新1 000-6 000次。

blocks.en: To evaluate prediction on unseen data, we assess both runs on the same 828 RoboCOIN clips from 100 episodes excluded from training, using their original trained direct heads without refitting. Table 10 reports the final-checkpoint errors. The mean gives equal weight to the three modalities. Mean error decreases from 0.6439 to 0.6354, a relative reduction of 1.32%, with the largest gains in RGB (4.06%) and depth (2.12%). The flow reduction is smaller (0.62%), and its 95% paired episode-bootstrap interval includes zero. Together, the training curves and held-out results show improved future-feature prediction, with the clearest benefits in RGB and depth.
blocks.zh: 为了评估对隐形数据的预测,我们评估这两集都运行在同一个828个RoboCOIN剪辑片段上,这些剪辑片段来自100个被排除在培训之外的节目,使用他们最初受过训练的直接头部,而无需换装. 表10报告了最后检查点的错误。 平均值对三种方式给予同等重视. 平均误差从0.6439降至0.6354,相对减少1.32%,在RGB(4.06%)和深度(2.12%)的增益最大。 流量的减少较小(0.62%),其95%的对接插曲-波茨夹间隔包括0. 培训曲线和停产结果加在一起,显示未来地貌预测有所改善,在RGB和深度方面效益最明显。

blocks.en: 5.3.2 Auxiliary Supervision for Action Policies
blocks.zh: 5.3.2 行动政策辅助监督

blocks.en: We first test whether self-generated subtask descriptions improve action success on LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) . At inference, the policy’s own VLM predicts the current subtask from the observations and task instruction, then appends the description to the instruction for action generation. Table 11 compares this setting with the same SFT checkpoint evaluated without preliminary subtask prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试自我生成的子任务描述是否改善LIBERO-Plus上的动作成功(Fei等人,2025年). 推论,策略本身的VLM从观测和任务指令中预测当前子任务,然后将描述附加到指令中以生成动作. 表11将这一设置与未经初步子任务预测而评价的SFT检查站进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 11: Self-generated subtask conditioning on LIBERO-Plus by perturbation category (success rate, %).
blocks.zh: 表11:按干扰类别分列的LIBERO-Plus上自行生成的子任务调节(成功率,%).

blocks.en: Subtask conditioning raises overall success from 89.93% to 90.23%. Its largest gains occur under robot-initial-state and camera-viewpoint perturbations ( + 1.16 +1.16 and + 1.00 +1.00 percentage points), with additional improvements under sensor noise and object-layout changes. Success decreases under lighting, language, and background-texture perturbations.
blocks.zh: 次级任务配置将总体成功率从89.93%提高到90.23%. 其最大的收益出现在机器人-初始状态和相机-视点扰动(+1.16+1.16和+1.00+1.00百分点)下,在感应噪声和物体放电变化下有额外的改进. 在照明、语言和背景文字扰动方面,成功率下降。

blocks.en: We examine how often self-generated subtask descriptions need to be refreshed during execution on eight RoboCasa365 ( Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) tasks, with 100 evaluation episodes per task under a fixed-seed setting. The policy’s VLM predicts the current subtask from the observations and task instruction. We compare refresh intervals of 1, 8, and 32 action chunks using the same subtask-conditioned checkpoint. Between refreshes, the description is reused while actions are generated from updated observations. A separately trained policy without subtask conditioning serves as the baseline (Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: 我们审查在执行8项RoboCasas365(Nasiriany等人,2026年)任务时,如何经常需要更新自我生成的子任务描述,每个任务在固定种子环境下有100个评价集。 策略的 VLM 从观测和任务指令中预测当前子任务 。 我们比较了刷新间隔的1,8和32个动作块 使用相同的副任务条件的检查站。 在刷新之间,描述被重新使用,同时通过更新的观测生成动作. 一项未经分任务规定单独培训的政策作为基线(表12)。

blocks.en: Table 12: RoboCasa365 success rates (%) with different subtask refresh intervals.
blocks.zh: 表12:不同子任务刷新间隔的RoboCasa365成功率(%).

blocks.en: Using refresh intervals of 1 or 8 chunks yields average success rates of 32.25% and 32.13%, respectively, compared with 26.25% for the baseline. These similar averages mask task-level differences: changing the interval from 1 to 8 reduces CuttingToolSelection success from 60% to 50%, but increases ArrangeTea success from 15% to 22%. Extending the interval to 32 reduces average success to 20.63%, below the baseline. An eight-chunk interval therefore gives similar aggregate success to per-chunk refreshes in this evaluation.

blocks.en: To characterize these updates, we measure the subtask change rate, defined as the percentage of successive predictions that differ. The rates are 11.6%, 26.5%, and 56.1% for refresh intervals of 1, 8, and 32 chunks, respectively. Most per-chunk predictions therefore repeat the preceding subtask.
blocks.zh: 为了描述这些更新,我们测量了子任务变化率,定义为连续预测中不同的百分比. 刷新间隔分别为1,8和32块,分别为11.6%、26.5%和56.1%。 因此,大多数每吨预测都重复了先前的子任务.

blocks.en: We examine whether ECoT supervision improves action success and whether its benefits require ECoT generation at inference. We compare a baseline trained without ECoT with a policy whose VLM is trained to generate ECoT responses that provide context to the action expert. The ECoT-trained checkpoint is evaluated both with and without generation at inference (Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 我们审查ECOT监督是否改善了行动的成功,其好处是否要求ECOT生成推论. 我们比较一个没有ECOT培训的基线,与一个其VLM培训为行动专家提供背景的ECOT响应的政策。 根据推论,对经ECoT培训的检查站进行评价,无论是否生成(表13)。

blocks.en: Table 13: Effects of ECoT training and inference-time generation on success rates (%).
blocks.zh: 表13: ECOT培训和推断时间生成对成功率的影响(%)。

blocks.en: Without ECoT generation at inference, ECoT training raises Long-suite success from 92.8% to 96.0% on LIBERO and from 65.18% to 69.87% on LIBERO-Plus, while LIBERO average success increases from 97.1% to 98.2%. Generating ECoT at inference provides no consistent additional gain: LIBERO average success increases slightly to 98.3%, but Long-suite success decreases to 95.6% and 68.72%, respectively. Aggregate LIBERO-Plus success is 79.25% without generation and 79.12% with it, both below the baseline’s 79.59%.
blocks.zh: 没有ECOT生成推论,ECOT培训将长期的成功率从LIBERO的92.8%提高到96.0%,将LIBERO-Plus的65.18%提高到69.87%,而LIBERO的平均成功率从97.1%提高到98.2%。 推论生成ECoT不会带来一致的额外收益:LIBERO的平均成功率略微上升至98.3%,但长期成功率分别下降至95.6%和68.72%. LIBERO-Plus的总成功率是79.25%不产生,79.12%不产生,都低于基准的79.59%。

blocks.en: Object-centric predictive methods use anticipated object configurations to guide manipulation: Goal-VLA recovers target object poses from generated goal images ( Chen et al., 2025d ) , while P2P-T learns future tool-pose representations to condition action generation ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Motivated by these approaches, we examine whether future object-pose prediction as an auxiliary training objective improves action success on LIBERO-Plus. Two auxiliary heads share a pooled representation of VLM-token hidden states: a classification head predicts whether the object moves, and a regression head predicts its translation and rotation increments over the next eight action steps. Both heads are used only during training. Table 14 compares this variant with the SFT baseline; neither uses subtask conditioning at inference.
blocks.zh: 以对象为中心的预测方法使用预期对象配置来指导操纵: Goal-VLA从生成的目标图像(Chen等人,2025d)中恢复了目标对象的姿势,而P2P-T则学习了未来的工具-pose表示以条件动作生成(Wang等人,2026b). 以这些方法为动力,我们审查未来作为辅助培训目标的目标对物体的预测是否改善了LIBERO-Plus上的动作成功。 两个辅助头共享一个集合代表 VLM-token 隐藏状态:一个分类头预测对象是否移动,一个回归头预测其翻译和在接下来的八个动作步骤上的旋转增量. 两头只用于训练. 表14将这一变体与SFT基线相比较;推论中均不使用子任务配置.

blocks.en: Table 14: Auxiliary object-pose supervision on LIBERO-Plus by perturbation category (success rate, %).
blocks.zh: 表14:按扰动类别划分的LIBERO-Plus辅助物体拥有监督(成功率,%).

blocks.en: Object-pose supervision increases overall success from 89.93% to 90.12%, a gain of 0.19 percentage points. Success improves under camera-viewpoint, sensor-noise, and object-layout perturbations, with the largest gain of 1.38 percentage points under viewpoint changes. It decreases in the other four categories, including drops of 0.87 percentage points under lighting changes and 0.64 under robot-initial-state changes.
blocks.zh: 物权监督将总体成功率从89.93%提高到90.12%,增长0.19个百分点。 相机-视点、传感器-噪音和物体射线扰动方面的成功有所改善,在视点变化下收益最大,为1.38个百分点。 其其他四类下降,包括灯光变化下下降0.87个百分点,机器人初始状态变化下下降0.64个百分点.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented PDRVLA, a VLA model that uses future prediction to learn compact physical representations for action generation. Direct supervision and a pretrained video world model shape these representations during training; at deployment, the policy uses the learned physical tokens without running the video model or prediction heads. Results across four simulation benchmarks demonstrate strong manipulation performance, while the prediction study shows that world-model assistance improves accuracy over direct supervision alone.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了PDRVLA,这是一个VLA模型,它利用未来的预测来学习紧凑的物理表达,用于行动生成. 直接监督和预先训练的视频世界模型在培训期间塑造了这些表现;部署时,政策使用学到的物理符号,而不运行视频模型或预测头. 四个模拟基准的结果显示了强大的操纵性能,而预测研究表明,仅靠世界模型协助就能提高准确性,而不是直接监督。

blocks.en: Future work will explore predictive targets beyond RGB, depth, and optical flow, including object-centric geometry, contact states, and material properties. We will investigate how these cues complement one another and contribute to action learning while retaining a lightweight policy.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将探索超出RGB,深度,光学流的预测目标,包括以物体为中心的几何,接触状态,以及物质属性. 我们将调查这些提示如何相互补充,促进行动学习,同时保留轻量级政策。

blocks.en: A.2 Frame Selection
blocks.zh: A.2 框架选择

blocks.en: We select starting frames for VLA training at regular intervals of approximately 0.125 s (8 Hz). We also add frames where a gripper or dexterous-hand target command changes by more than a threshold between consecutive frames. Each manipulator’s available gripper and hand channels are checked separately. We combine the two sets of candidates and remove frames that are too close together, keeping frames with command changes in preference to regularly sampled frames. The minimum spacing is 0.01 s, converted to a frame interval using the episode’s frame rate. The remaining candidates must pass the sample-validity checks described in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们定期选择大约0.125秒(8赫兹)的志愿军训练起点。 我们还添加了在连续的帧之间,一个抓取器或 dexterous-hand目标命令改变超过阈值的帧. 每个操纵者可用的握手和手道都单独检查。 我们把两组候选人合并起来,去掉太接近的帧,使帧与命令变化保持一致,偏向于定期取样的帧. 最小间隔为0.01s,使用插曲的帧率转换成帧间隔. 其余候选人必须通过第4.2节所述的抽样有效性检查。

blocks.zh: A.3 世界示范培训预科比较

blocks.en: The comparison in Section 5.3 tests whether adding world-model supervision improves future prediction. Both runs use direct future-feature supervision; Direct + WM additionally includes the auxiliary world-model objective. The two runs share the following settings. blocks.en: We evaluate the trained physical modules and their original direct prediction heads without refitting or updating parameters. Both runs use the same 828 RoboCOIN clips from 100 held-out episodes and identical target-normalization statistics. blocks.en: Appendix B Physical-Module Design Choices
blocks.zh: 附录B 物理单元 设计选择

blocks.en: We select four physical-module settings in sequence: the VLM input layer, cross-attention placement, direct-supervision weighting, and query count. At each stage, we retain the settings selected in the preceding stages and compare candidates for the next choice. For each candidate, we train the physical module with the original Qwen3.5-4B backbone, then freeze both the VLM and physical module and fit a new linear readout to predict future features. The readout measures how readily future information can be recovered from the learned representations. We use validation scores to select configurations, with the single-seed results summarized in Table 15 .
blocks.zh: 我们按顺序选择四个物理模块设置: VLM 输入层,交叉注意位置,直视加权和查询计数. 在每一个阶段,我们保留前几个阶段所选择的设置,并比较下一个选择的候选人。 对于每个候选者,我们用原来的Quen3.5-4B主干来训练物理模块,然后冻结VLM和物理模块,并装上一个新的线性读取,以预测未来的特性. 阅读量度衡量如何从学到的表述中随时找到未来的信息。 我们使用验证分数来选择配置,单种子结果摘要见表15。

blocks.en: The design study uses a 500k-example training pool, 6,000 optimization steps, seed 42, and learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} . Physical-module hidden width, block count, head count, output width, and feed-forward expansion ratio are fixed at 1024, 4, 4, 2560, and 1. The world-model-assisted loss has weight 1 throughout these design comparisons.
blocks.zh: 设计研究采用500k-example训练池,6000优化步骤,种子42,学习率3×10−4 3\time 10×4}. 物理模块隐藏宽度,块数,头数,输出宽度,以及向导扩展比被固定为1024,4,4,2560和1. 通过这些设计比较,世界模型辅助损失具有重量1。

blocks.en: We first compare VLM input layers using 256 queries, cross-attention at every physical-module block, and a constant direct-loss weight of 0.1. We then fix the selected VLM Block 8 and compare cross-attention placements, retaining 256 queries and weight 0.1; parameter counts vary with the number of cross-attention blocks. Next, we retain Block 8, every-block cross-attention, and 256 queries while comparing direct-loss weights and warm-up schedules. Finally, we compare query counts using Block 8, every-block cross-attention, and the selected direct-loss schedule, which warms up to 0.5 over 2,000 steps.
blocks.zh: 我们首先用256个查询来比较VLM输入层,每个物理单元块的交叉注意,以及0.1的恒定直接损失重量. 然后,我们修正选定的VLM区块8,并比较交叉注意位置,保留256个查询和重量0.1;参数计数随交叉注意区块的数目而变化。 其次,我们保留第8区,每个区交叉注意,以及256个查询,同时比较直接损失加权数和热身表。 最后,我们用Block 8来比较查询数,每个Block-block-cross-attention, 和选定的直接损失时间表, 它温暖到0.5到2000步。

blocks.en: During readout fitting and evaluation, the VLM and physical module remain frozen. Masked mean pooling produces a 2560-dimensional representation, from which an affine ridge readout predicts pooled future RGB, depth, and color-encoded flow latent targets. The probe data span five source families, with 2,048 clips for readout fitting and a separate set of 1,024 validation clips for scoring each configuration. Within the fitting pool, an episode-separated split of 1,665 fitting clips and 383 validation clips is used to select the regularization strength. We then refit the readout on all 2,048 fitting clips before scoring it on the separate validation set. Readout fitting uses FP64 standardized spectral ridge, with standardization statistics estimated from fitting data only.
blocks.zh: 在读出安装和评价期间,甚高频和物理模块仍然冻结。 Masked意味着集合产生一个2560维的表示,从这个表示中,一个近缘脊读数预测了集合未来RGB,深度,以及色码流潜在目标. 探测数据跨越五个来源区,其中2 048个用于读出装配的剪辑,另外还有1 024个用于评分每个配置的验证剪辑。 在装配池内,使用1,665个装配片段和383个验证片段的插座分隔来选择规范化强度. 然后重排所有2 048个装配剪辑的读数 然后再在单独的验证组上评分 读出装配采用FP64标准化光谱脊,标准化统计仅根据配配配数据估算。

blocks.en: Block 8 gives the highest score among the tested VLM layers (0.3617 versus 0.2432 for the final block), supporting intermediate-layer input. Cross-attention at every physical-module block scores slightly higher than final-block-only access (0.3617 versus 0.3590). With world-model supervision retained, adding direct supervision with the selected weight warm-up raises the score from 0.2683 to 0.3834, the highest among the tested weighting schemes. Under this schedule, 50 queries achieve 0.3844, close to 0.3834 for 256 queries, supporting the compact token sequence.
blocks.zh: 区块8给出了经过测试的VLM层中最高的分数(最终区块0.3617对0.2432),支持中间层输入. 每个物理单元区块的交叉参赛得分略高于最终区块仅限区块访问(0.3617比0.3590). 随着世界模式监督的保持,加上直接监督与选定的重量热身,将分数从0.2683提高到0.3834,这是测试加权办法中最高的. 在这个时间表下,50个查询达到0.3844,对256个查询来说接近0.3834,支持紧凑符号序列.

blocks.en: Appendix D Franka End-Effector Pose Distribution Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录D Pose 分布诊断

blocks.en: We examine absolute end-effector (EEF) height distributions in the Franka data from the pretraining mixture and LIBERO, and assess whether the normalization range from pretraining covers the LIBERO observations. The comparison focuses on distribution differences associated with scene geometry, even when the robot embodiment is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们审查来自预训练混合物和LIBERO的Franka数据中绝对末端效应器高度分布,并评估从预训练到LIBERO观测的正常化范围。 比较的重点是与场景几何相关的分布差异,即使机器人的化身没有变化.

blocks.en: We inspect 75 Franka configuration entries from the pretraining mixture and the four LIBERO suites. For each entry, we sample up to eight shards and eight row groups per selected shard, targeting approximately 2,048 frames with seed 42. The audit yields 143,507 valid arm-level poses from 162,081 sampled frames; seven RobotSet entries lack EEF poses and are recorded as missing. Positions are interpreted in meters according to source metadata and retained in their original coordinate frames.
blocks.zh: 我们检查75个Franka配置条目 从预训混合物和四个LIBERO套房。 每一个条目,我们每个选定的硬度取样最多8个硬度和8个排组,瞄准约2 048帧,种子42。 审计结果从162 081个抽样框架中得出143 507个有效臂级姿势;7个RobotSet条目没有EEF姿势,被记录为缺失。 位置按照源元数据以米法解释,保留在原来的坐标框中.

blocks.en: The pretraining right-arm position statistics examined in the audit have a first-to-99th-percentile z z interval of approximately [ − 0.096 , 0.772 ] [-0.096,0.772] m. We use its upper bound of 0.772 m as a reference to examine the coverage of LIBERO EEF heights.
blocks.zh: 审计中审查的训练前右臂位置统计的z z 的第一至九9%间隔约为[−0.096,0.772] [0.096,0.772] m. 我们用它的上界0.772米作为参考,来检查LIBERO EEF高度的覆盖范围.

blocks.en: LIBERO Spatial and Goal use tabletops at 0.90 m, Object uses a floor-level workspace, and Long combines living-room, kitchen, and study scenes with work surfaces at 0.41, 0.90, and 0.867 m, respectively. Checks of the original NVIDIA LIBERO position fields confirm that the suite-level height differences are present before pose conversion. The suite-dependent height ranges are consistent with these scene geometries. Table 17 compares the sampled heights with the examined pretraining upper bound.
blocks.zh: LIBERO Space和Goal在0.90米处使用台表,Object在0.80米处使用地板工作空间,Long在0.41,0.90和0.867米处分别将生活室,厨房和学习场景与工作表面相结合. 对原始的NVIDIA LIBERO位置字段的检查确认,套房高度差异在摆设转换前存在. 套房依赖的高度范围与这些场景几何相符合. 表17将取样高度与检查前的上限进行对比。

blocks.en: Table 17: Sampled absolute EEF-height statistics in LIBERO. The pretraining upper bound is 0.772 m.
blocks.zh: 表17:LIBERO的EEF-hight绝对统计数据样本。 预先训练的上界为0.772米.

blocks.en: All sampled Spatial and Goal positions and 49.1% of sampled Long positions exceed the reference upper bound. The differences across suites illustrate how a shared robot embodiment can still have different absolute pose distributions because of scene geometry, affecting the coverage of a normalization range transferred between datasets.
blocks.zh: 所有取样的空间和目标位置以及49.1%的抽样的长位置超过了参考值上限。 不同套房的差异说明了共享的机器人化身由于场景几何而仍然可以拥有不同的绝对姿势分布,影响了数据集之间传输的正常化范围的覆盖范围.
